items.quote: Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent.
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses to have Aaron throw his rod down in front of Pharaoh, and that the rod would turn into a serpent.
items.actor: Aaron (instructed by the LORD via Moses)

items.quote: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses and Aaron that Pharaoh would ask them for a miracle, and that this request would be the signal for the rod sign.
